learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the character of an expert in the field; a person with the practical skills to address complex economic and business management problems with clear and solid professional criteria, and with the necessary technical instruments.
Understand and assimilate what a company is and how it works: how it is organized and how the different functions within it are related (management, procurement, production, sales, ...).
Understand the accounting process within the company, being able to obtain and interpret a company's balance sheet by applying accounting principles.
Understand the process of calculating and managing costs in a company, being able to establish an objective plan by functional areas and reach the expected result of the company's activity.
Understand the functioning of markets: intervening agents, their conditions, and price determination mechanisms.

Define and understand what the main macroeconomic indicators are, how they act and what they measure, and what macroeconomic policies are and how they act, being able to relate policies and indicators.
Ability to analyze and interpret what happens at the business level and at the global economic level.
Become familiar with reading economic press.
Ability to organize and plan in the field of business and other institutions and organizations.
Ability to apply the principles and methods of business management.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Adopt a responsible, organized attitude at work and be willing to learn, considering the challenge that continuous training will pose.

Apply the strategies of the scientific methodology: Analyze problematic situations qualitatively and quantitatively, propose hypotheses and solutions using the models typical of Industrial Engineering and its corresponding specialty.
Work effectively in a group, integrating capacities to make decisions in the field of Industrial Engineering and its corresponding specialty.
Understand the basic concepts of economic theory and analyze the influence of the economic and social environment on business activities.
Analyze the concept of a company and describe its objectives, importance, characteristics, modalities, and evolution over time.
Know and correctly apply business vocabulary.

syllabus_topics: Topic 2: Concept of company, functional and organizational structure
Topic 4: Business context in organizations of different sectors

assessment_methods.method: Completion of practical assignments (exercises, cases or problems)

assessment_rules: The subject is divided into 2 parts: Economics and Business Administration. The written exam consists of two parts; to pass, it is necessary to obtain at least 35% in each part and at least 50% of the total exam score. For continuous assessment, practical assignments and teamwork are mandatory, requiring a minimum grade of 5 out of 10 or equivalent, and a minimum of 5 out of 10 or equivalent is also required on the written exam. Students can opt out of continuous assessment by choosing the final assessment system within 9 weeks from the start of the semester. In the extraordinary examination, students will be evaluated exclusively through a final assessment system, which can account for 100% of the grade, and positive results obtained during the course may be retained if the professor deems it appropriate.
